## Method and practical limits

34 frozen French BuildLearn questions were labeled from the actual indexed children before searching. Labels include full source identity, alternative chunk IDs and exact source substrings. All labels are validated against the live payloads at startup. Multiple evidence units are required facts; IDs within a unit are alternatives. Exact matching is case-sensitive and preserves source OCR. No answer or source text is generated.

Every query is passed through the existing HierarchicalRetriever at each of the 48 configurations (two modes, four K values, six thresholds). Only query embeddings are cached in memory across configurations; Qdrant searches and verified source resolution are executed for each retrieval. No sibling fetches or LLM calls occur. Parent expansion uses the existing 6,000-character budget.

Hit@K means at least one labeled evidence unit is found in the first K ranked hits, or its verified parent context in parent mode. MRR uses the first such rank and is truncated at the evaluated K. Document recall is the fraction of distinct labeled source identities retrieved. Exact evidence recall uses child IDs only; substring recall uses child text plus verified parents in parent mode, scoped to the labeled source. Combined evidence recall is their union. Metrics are macro-averaged over questions; average score is micro-averaged over returned hits. Empty count includes all questions with no returned hits. Parent expansion does not alter child scores or document rankings.

This is a small, manually curated calibration set, not an exhaustive relevance judgment or held-out benchmark. General questions have incomplete positive labels, so an unlabelled result may be valid. It contains no unanswerable negative queries: threshold precision/abstention cannot be established. The selected threshold is the highest tested value that loses no measured recall/MRR or nonempty coverage at the selected K; it is not a calibrated relevance probability. Exact/near-duplicate sources are deliberately retained as distinct source identities. Failure categories are overlapping triage signals, not proven causal diagnoses. Parser signals identify visibly damaged indexed evidence without modifying parsing or chunking.

## Measured findings

At the selected configuration, 10/34 questions have at least one labeled evidence hit. Combined evidence recall is 27.94%; document recall is 42.65%; MRR is 0.1912. This measured evidence coverage is insufficient to claim strong retrieval quality.

Verified parent expansion changes combined evidence recall by +0.00% compared with child-only at the same settings. Expansion can provide useful surrounding text without supplying the particular labeled facts; a zero metric gain must not be described as an evidence-recall improvement.

| Question category (overlapping) | Questions | Hits | Combined evidence recall |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| application/use | 4 | 0 | 0.0000 |
| consumption | 4 | 2 | 0.3750 |
| cross-document ambiguity | 2 | 2 | 0.7500 |
| dimensions | 4 | 1 | 0.2500 |
| highly specific | 6 | 2 | 0.3333 |
| preparation/application instructions | 4 | 3 | 0.7500 |
| product identification | 3 | 1 | 0.3333 |
| safety/limitations | 5 | 1 | 0.2000 |
| standards/norms | 3 | 0 | 0.0000 |
| substrate/support compatibility | 2 | 1 | 0.5000 |
| technical specifications | 8 | 2 | 0.2500 |
| vague/general | 3 | 0 | 0.0000 |

All six tested thresholds produce identical metrics and returned-score averages at every K/mode. Threshold calibration has no observed discriminatory value on this positive-only set. The 0.6 recommendation is the predeclared lossless tie-break among tested thresholds; there is no measured superiority over 0.0–0.5. Add independently judged ambiguous and unanswerable queries before relying on threshold-based abstention.

## Failure triage at recommended configuration

```json
{
  "duplicate/near-duplicate source issue": 4,
  "embedding/retrieval issue": 22,
  "label ambiguity": 4,
  "parser/chunking issue": 2
}
```

Embedding/retrieval signals require broader query/model analysis; parser signals require a corpus-wide audit before any changes. Ambiguous labels need additional human judgments. Duplicate signals require source/version review. Threshold losses are measured against the same mode/K at threshold 0.0. No pipeline tuning was performed.

## Reproduction and executed tests

Run from `backend` using the existing virtual environment:

```powershell
.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -B scripts/evaluate_hierarchical_retrieval.py --qdrant-url http://127.0.0.1:6333 --ollama-url http://127.0.0.1:11434
```

The script writes this report and prints all configuration metrics and every failed query/configuration, including expected evidence, returned documents/chunks, scores, section paths and block types. The final run produced 1,632 per-query records and 1,272 failure diagnostic records, both verified in the report and terminal output. A failure includes partial evidence recall, even if Hit@K is positive. The running Qdrant server may append read-request access logs; collection payloads/vectors and protected source/checkpoint hashes remained unchanged.

```powershell
.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest tests/ai/test_hierarchical_retrieval_eval.py tests/ai/test_retriever.py tests/ai/test_context_builder.py tests/ai/test_embeddings.py tests/ai/test_vectorstore.py tests/ai/test_hierarchical_retriever.py tests/ai/test_hierarchical_indexer.py tests/ai/test_hierarchical_pipeline.py tests/ai/test_technical_chunker.py tests/ai/test_hierarchical_chunker.py tests/ai/test_rag_service.py tests/ai/test_llm_provider.py tests/ai/rag -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage\.tmp\retrieval_eval_regression_final --tb=short
```

Final result: **355 passed, 0 failures**, including **21 new offline evaluation tests**, in 7.35 seconds. There were 1,824 existing datetime/fixture deprecation warnings. Tests cover metrics, alternative labels, source-scoped matching, parent evidence, empty results, required multi-source facts, score averages, query caching, collection isolation, label validity, overlapping failure triage, measured recommendation selection, the complete configuration grid, UTF-8 query preservation and report diagnostics. Test outputs use workspace temporary directories outside indexing data.

An initial live run revealed that PowerShell stdin had replaced accented query characters with question marks. Frozen queries were corrected and checked before the final evaluation; this report contains the corrected queries and their final measurements. No parser, chunking, model, index, retriever default or endpoint changes were made in response to failures.
